claims.text: Carefully tuned short-range ordering in lightweight HEAs can establish stable protective oxide layers.
Carefully tuned short-range ordering in lightweight HEAs can produce nanoscale precipitates.
SRO-bearing lightweight HEAs can concurrently provide lower density, greater strength, and improved corrosion and oxidation resistance relative to alloys lacking SRO.
An Al–Ti–Cr–V–X alloy is an example of a lightweight HEA suitable for the proposed comparison.
Tailoring Al–Ti–Cr ratios can engineer short-range ordering.
Temperatures of 700–1000 °C under oxidizing or corrosive atmospheres and tensile loading resemble relevant aerospace or rail-service conditions.
Multi-principal-element solute interactions drive local ordering and secondary-phase precipitation.
Local ordering and secondary-phase precipitation create a continuous protective oxide or nitride scale.
Local ordering and secondary-phase precipitation impede dislocation motion.
Short-range ordering promotes a uniform Al2O3 or Cr2O3 protective layer at elevated temperature.
Short-range ordering enhances solid-solution or precipitation strengthening.
The SRO-targeted alloy will have lower oxidation mass gain than the baseline alloy.
The SRO-targeted alloy will have lower corrosion current density than the baseline alloy.
The SRO-targeted alloy will have at least 10–20% greater yield strength than the baseline alloy.
Reducing Al–Ti–Cr content will yield minimal or no short-range ordering.
Processing or service conditions that disrupt SRO or produce unstable phases can prevent formation of the protective scale or favorable precipitates.
Many conventional HEAs have high density that inhibits practical deployment.
HEAs as a broad class can exhibit high yield strength, corrosion resistance, and high-temperature oxidation resistance.
The amount of local ordering and combination of alloying additions needed for the proposed performance gains may vary across alloy families and processing methods.
APT or XRD can confirm the proposed short-range ordering or nanoscale precipitates.
